sections.title: Keyboard navigation
sections.notes: The populated keyboard table’s specific actions are mapped by date-keyboard-enter-save, date-keyboard-page-month, date-keyboard-home-end, date-keyboard-shift-page-year, date-keyboard-shift-m-month-list, and date-keyboard-shift-y-year-list. The first Enter/Return row repeats the key name as its action and does not define behavior, so that row remains unresolved. The month/year rows also do not state the direction for each individual Page key.

sections.title: Labeling elements
sections.notes: The field label/helper requirements are represented by date-input-label-help and date-format-helper-text; the control labels, button roles, weekday column-header label and month-grid label are represented by date-calendar-navigation-control-labels, date-weekday-column-header-label and date-month-grid-label.

sections.title: Screen reader verbalizations
sections.notes: All actionable instructions in this section are represented by the linked checks.

checks.statement: Use docked, modal, or modal-input date pickers according to context; clearly distinguish today and selected dates.
checks.condition: When people need a date or date range.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Date pickers guidance.

checks.statement: Use modal pickers in compact layouts and docked pickers with a text field/dropdown in medium or expanded layouts.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage guidance.

checks.statement: Provide a date input field and a dropdown calendar so users can choose either text entry or the picker.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Docked date picker guidance.
Separated the input-method requirement from the independently assessable month/year navigation requirement.

checks.statement: Do not use a modal calendar picker for dates in the distant past or future, such as birth dates; use modal input or a docked picker.
checks.condition: When selecting a date picker for distant dates.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Modal date picker guidance.

checks.statement: For a modal date range, let users select a start date and an end date on the calendar.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Date range selection guidance.
Separated range endpoint selection from the independently assessable month navigation behavior.

checks.statement: Use modal date input when a calendar is unnecessary; allow switching between modal calendar and input using the edit or calendar icon.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Modal date input guidance.

checks.statement: At compact breakpoints, use the recommended full-screen modal picker to improve readability and touch target size.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Compact breakpoint guidance.

checks.statement: Do not scale docked or modal date picker dimensions responsively across breakpoints.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Responsive layout guidance.

checks.statement: Format a manually entered date only after Enter or when focus leaves the field; do not insert masking characters while the user types.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Accessible date input guidance.
Separated deferred formatting from the independently assessable accepted input formats.

checks.statement: Remove the Clear button when it is not needed to reduce keyboard tab stops.
checks.condition: When the Clear action is optional.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Optional Clear button guidance.

checks.statement: Maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast between date link text and its background.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Color contrast between dates guidance.
Clarified that the contrast ratio applies to date link text against its background.

checks.statement: Label the date field by its purpose and make that label match the placeholder while the field is empty.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling elements guidance.
Separated the field-label requirement from the separately assessable date-format helper text.

checks.statement: Use the context-based M3 names docked date picker, modal date picker, and modal date input; modal variants communicate that the user must take an action.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Differences from M2 instructions.

checks.statement: Embed a modal date picker in a dialog at compact breakpoints and a docked picker in a text-field dropdown at medium or expanded breakpoints.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

checks.statement: Use a docked picker for near or distant past/future dates because it supports multiple date-entry methods.
checks.condition: When selecting dates across a wide time range.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Docked date picker instructions.

checks.statement: Make keyboard entry and calendar navigation available as soon as a docked picker is accessed.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Behavior instructions.

checks.statement: Let users move between months with previous/next arrows or a month dropdown.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Month selection instructions.

checks.statement: Let users move between years with previous/next arrows or a year dropdown.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Year selection instructions.

checks.statement: Navigate between modal-picker months with horizontal swipes, between years with vertical scrolling, and open the year picker by selecting the year.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Behavior instructions.

checks.statement: Navigate between months in a modal range picker by vertical scrolling.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Date range selection instructions.

checks.statement: Use modal date input for manually entering one date or a date range; it may be the default when a calendar is unnecessary, and a hinted text field is another option.
checks.condition: When dates do not require calendar selection.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

checks.statement: Allow switching between a modal calendar and date input using the edit or calendar icon.
checks.condition: For modal date pickers that support manual entry.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Behavior instructions.

checks.statement: Use color to distinguish the selected date from today; for a range, mark start and end dates and connect the intervening dates with a subtle highlight.
checks.condition: When displaying selected dates or a range.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Selection instructions.

checks.statement: Let users confirm with OK or dismiss with Cancel; modal pickers may also dismiss on outside interaction, while a compact full-screen picker provides a close icon and Save. A docked picker appears below its input.
checks.condition: When opening or closing date pickers.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Appearing and disappearing instructions.

checks.statement: Allow manual text entry without requiring the picker; the docked field accepts input, and modal pickers expose date input through an edit icon.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Use cases instructions.

checks.statement: Keep all interactive targets at least 48×48dp and avoid density that reduces target size.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Interaction & style instructions.

checks.statement: Offer direct text entry and picker entry as separate inputs and tab stops; use the calendar icon as the exclusive entry point to the date picker.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Date entry methods instructions.

checks.statement: Accept common date formats using dashes, spaces, slashes, or dots, including a leading zero for single-digit month/day values.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Accessible date input instructions.

checks.statement: Show the shortcut key in the tooltip and include it in the hint description announced by screen readers.
checks.condition: For date-picker controls with keyboard shortcuts.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Affordance for keyboard shortcuts instructions.

checks.statement: Use tooltips to expose full truncated labels on hover or keyboard focus; weekday labels are not keyboard-focusable, so their tooltip is available on pointer hover only.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Truncated labels & tooltips instructions.

checks.statement: Use helper text below the date field to specify and describe its input format; the default MM/DD/YYYY may be customized.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling elements instructions.

checks.statement: Expose a complete date label including weekday, month, day, and year instead of announcing only the day number.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Screen reader verbalizations instructions.

checks.statement: Pressing Enter/Return closes the calendar and saves the selected date.
checks.condition: When a date is selected in the calendar.
checks.notes: Captured the explicit Enter/Return action row that closes and saves the selected date.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the explicit Enter/Return action row that closes and saves the selected date.

checks.statement: Page Up and Page Down move to the same date in the next or previous month.
checks.condition: When navigating dates with the calendar focused.
checks.notes: The captured table says next/previous month for Page up/down without assigning each direction to an individual key. Preserve that wording rather than infer a per-key direction.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the previous/next month relationship in the keyboard table.

checks.statement: Home and End move to the first day of the month.
checks.notes: The captured table assigns both Home and End to the first day of the month; this wording preserves the source even though the pairing may be unusual.

sourceHistory.summary: The captured table assigns both Home and End to the first day of the month; this wording preserves the source even though the pairing may be unusual.

checks.statement: Shift+Page Up and Shift+Page Down move to the same date in the next or previous year.
checks.condition: When navigating dates with the calendar focused.
checks.notes: The captured table says next/previous year for Shift + Page up/down without assigning each direction to an individual key. Preserve that wording rather than infer a per-key direction.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the same-date and previous/next year relationship in the keyboard table.

checks.statement: Shift+M moves to the month-list dropdown.
checks.condition: When navigating date-picker controls by keyboard.
checks.notes: Captured the shortcut destination exactly as the keyboard table states.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the shortcut destination exactly as the keyboard table states.

checks.statement: Shift+Y moves to the year-list dropdown.
checks.condition: When navigating date-picker controls by keyboard.
checks.notes: Captured the shortcut destination exactly as the keyboard table states.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the shortcut destination exactly as the keyboard table states.

checks.statement: Give previous/next month and year controls and the month/year dropdown controls the accessibility label “{label}” and the Button role.
checks.condition: For calendar navigation and month/year dropdown controls.
checks.notes: Preserves table element, accessibility-label and role relationships for both sets of navigation controls.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves table element, accessibility-label and role relationships for both sets of navigation controls.

checks.statement: Expose days of the week with the accessibility label “Column header”.
checks.notes: Preserves the table label assigned to the days-of-week element; no role is listed in the source row.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the table label assigned to the days-of-week element; no role is listed in the source row.

checks.statement: Expose the month grid with the accessibility label “Grid”.
checks.notes: Preserves the table accessibility label for the month grid; no role is listed in the source row.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the table accessibility label for the month grid; no role is listed in the source row.
